t: A powerful eight-core Linux board with two fast network ports and an AI helper.
steps: Buy the board from the Orange Pi Official store on Amazon or another reseller. Pick the 4, 8 or 16 GB version.
Get a 5 volt 4 amp USB-C power supply and a microSD card.
Download Ubuntu or Debian for the board from the official Orange Pi download page.
Write the image to the microSD card with an image writing app.
Insert the card and connect power, an HDMI screen, a keyboard and a mouse.
Follow the setup steps in the Orange Pi 5 Plus user manual.
Try the 40-pin header examples in the manual to blink an LED.
Add an NVMe SSD later for faster storage.
meta: Open Board. From $367. A few stores.
